snippet.title: Hop Hop Hop (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/hop-hop-hop/id1054818220?at=11lGxL&ct=youtube-hophophop

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.hophophop

Jump into the hoops and avoid the spikes. Collect mushrooms to unlock all the funny characters!

How far can you go?

→ Eat a mushroom to get 1 point
→ Jump into the hoop from above to get 2 points
→ You have enough skills to do it from below? Get 3 points!
